batting.name: F du Plessis
batting.dismissal: c Mohammed Siraj b Arshad Khan

batting.name: Abishek Porel
batting.dismissal: c JC Buttler b R Sai Kishore

batting.name: AR Patel
batting.dismissal: c R Sai Kishore b M Prasidh Krishna

balls.text: Smart wide yorker from Siraj. He saw Rahul make room, landed it just inside the off side tramline. Way too far for Rahul to do anything. Reviewed by DC but it's well inside. In fact, Rahul raises his bat and went past the boundary before the replay shows up
Siraj goes for another yorker, misses on the shorter side. Gets away with it as Stubbs had cleared his front leg too far. Tried to slog it over long-on, toes it to midwicket
Jumping pull! Whacks a head-high bouncer from beside his shoulder. Fifth-stump bouncer dragged over deep square leg. Even Gill is impressed.
141ks, near-yorker again. Rahul gets underneath by sliding his front leg leg side. Picks up the flick to deep square leg's right. Stopped on the bounce
Very low full toss, almost a yorker but Rahul creams it through extra. Back knee bent low to get under the ball, the line was around fourth stump which helped him.

That's out if it hasn't hit bat. Siraj appealed for lbw, Gill wasn't convinced but takes the review with three seconds to go. Ump called it runs. Indeed it was. Rahul went for the reverse paddle over short third to a near-yorker on off stump. The bat was scraping up and the ball went off the moving right toe of the bat, between the feet and through fine leg
Perfect 141ks yorker has Stubbs sliding out of the way, he manages to clip it through midwicket and scampers back for two
Yorker at 145ks following him as he makes room, jammed to long-off

Rahul brings up his fifth hundred with a pull in front of square. He has a word with his partner before getting his lid out and soaking in the rousing cheers. Big smile on KP too. Was a shortish ball that came around belly-height. Hit flat
Full ball down leg, goes past the flick

Remarkable shot, it's like a horizontal bat shot but was actually more of a lofted off drive. Played it in front of the waist while backing away. Was a length ball following him, cramped him for room but it didn't matter
Makes room early, Prasidh smartly bowls at fifth stump. 145ks and full. Stubbs has to stretch out to bunt it to deep point
Might've been seam-up. Under-edge goes low and too quickly for Buttler to get more than a fingertip. Was a quick length ball outside off that Stubbs tried to flat-bat over the bowler
Stubbs is able to use the angle in though. Clears the front leg late, it actually touched the leg-side tramline to open up his hips for the pull. Flat over forward square leg for six.
Square driven through point. Was a 96ks length ball angling in sharply, finished on middle and Rahul looked cramped for room. Bottom hand came off, so might've been hurried too
A bit of turn away. Landed around fifth and Stubbs had to reach out with his torso to cut through extra cover
Rahul dances down and Sai Kishore slows it down. Floats it wide on a length, slashed to long-off
Length on off, 95ks, pushed to long-off, who's slightly wide
Short ball rises only to waist-height, Stubbs tucks it softly to midwicket and takes off. Looked like the pull was on there, Stubbs decided to use it as a sighter instead
Tucked the low full toss to square leg
Deft pull to short fine leg's left. Short fine was in and Prasidh went slow at middle and leg. Rahul waited for the most part, bent low and got the front leg out the way to rake it into the ground
Into the pitch, at the hip, clipped off the back foot to long leg

Taken at deep third. Sai Kishore didn't spot it initially, but then took off to the right and took it around the bread basket. He was placed very fine too. Was a shortish ball angling in. Axar limboed back and and upper cut it, more of a glide actually as there was no follow-through. Timed it well, placement not
Wide on a shortish length, looked slow, Axar tries to drag it over midwicket with a pull. Misses
Shortish on top of off, skiddy 96ks ball, pulled on the bounce to deep midwicket
Gets on one knee and slog sweeps it over the bowler. He'd pulled one over the bowler early on and now this. Sai Kishore went wide again, fullish and a touch slow
Pacer's bumper from Sai Kishore, sits up and reaches around waist-height. Axar read it but couldn't middle the pull, skied it to deep midwicket. Lucky for him, it lands safe
Yorker on off, worked along the ground through midwicket.
Wide on a fullish length, looks to heave across the line. Misses
Slapped over the leaping bowler. A wide length ball and Axar flat-batted it against the angle
This spins away. Started wide and ended close to the tramline. Axar reaches out and slashes to long-off
Short, spins in and Axar pulls it hard along the ground. Beats deep-backward square to the left

Siraj is charging to his diagonal right from long-off, but can't get there. Big slide too, has to run back to pick it up. Was a wide length ball that Axar tried to drag across over midwicket while upright. Toed it as his weight was going leg side. That didn't bounce much either
Length on fifth, 95ks, pushed with soft hands to point
Four deep fielders leg side and Rashid goes fullish at Axar's legs. 96ks, seemed to pick up pace late. Axar tries to swat it square, edges it behind square
Cut to deep point. A touch short, turns away to fifth stump. Gets away with it. 96ks
Sweeps hard but the contact isn't good. Underedge goes to backward square leg
Has a hack across the line, misses. Sai Kishore's lbw appeal is turned down
Length on off, touch of turn away, worked off the back foot to deep square leg

Turn away, edge found, goes through the vacant first-slip area. Axar-esque from Sai Kishore again. 1'o clock release, angling in towards leg stump before turning late. Rahul tried to nudge it square, got a leading edge

Rabada slides right at long-on but his knees might have jarred. Maybe the fielder coming across had him weary. In the end, he parries it over the rope. Was a full ball that was flicked along the ground
Rahul dances down and whacks it back. Might be considered a chance but Sai Kishore couldn't get low enough in follow-through and the ball went through his legs
Looped up teasingly, Rahul clears the back leg and looks to whip through mid-on, inside edges to short fine leg. 89ks
Length on off, worked off the back foot to long-on
Spin in, likely the googly. Beat the flick and the lbw appeal was subdued as that looked to be going down leg. Was a length ball that landed around off and hit him in front of leg
Full n off, whipped between long-on and deep midwicket
Length on leg, clipped to deep square leg
Fullish 94ks ball on fourth, flicked along the ground through midwicket

Porel cuts, Buttler takes a sharp catch. 94ks ball on a slightly short of length, drifting away close to the tramline. Porel reached out and looked to cut behind square. Thinnish edge from low off the bat, deflected towards Buttler's left.

Over the wicket and Porel helps himself for a six downtown. The ball was angling in this time, fifth-stump front-of-the-hand ball. Went straight on and at an even pace and bounce. Porel was beside the line and drove it high
Wide on a length, Axar-like slingy delivery close to the off-side tramline. Beats the cut
Slows it down. 88ks on a length at fifth, pushed to cover point
Flat on a length at off, 94ks, cut late again. Finds short third
Touch short and wide, Porel waits in the crease and uses the angle to late cut to short third. Perhaps wanted to find the gap, but found the fielder on the bounce
Looked like a legcutter. 118ks, fullish on leg, clipped softly to the edge of the ring at midwicket for a smart two
Slow and short just outside off. Porel waits, jumps and wipes it to deep third
Pitched up, pushed down the ground for a single
Tonked over the bowler. Makes room and drives a fullish ball that was following him 79 metres far
Risky run. Gets away with it. No direct hit from mid-off. Was a full ball around off that was firmly driven before Porel took off
Picked up high, goes five rows past the fine-leg boundary. Was a full ball on the knee-roll, was on leg stump and Porel didn't move. Just flicked it low to high
fuller, and just outside off. Pushed to cover

Missed chance, and also four! Rahul goes sweeping and slogging again, and this ball dips on a length outside off and straightens. Rahul gets a top edge behind the wicket, and Sai Kishore, at short third, dives to his left, but can't get a hand
full ball on middle and off, and punched to long-off

Buttler is up and celebrating a potential caught-behind chance... only for the umpire to call it wide. Rashid also looks convinced it's out, and GT review. It was a short delivery well outside leg, and turned in to finish even wider. Porel had his front leg out of the way to pull, but missed. UltraEdge shows absolutely nothing - neither bat nor pad - and the ball remains a wide
short in length again, and on off. Whipped to long-on

slogged to deep square leg, and that is Rahul's fifty. It was the googly from Rashid, who went fuller, but got the line comfortable enough, and the line straight enough. Rahul went swinging, and placed the ball in the gap
shorter side of a length, and just outside off. There's not much room to cut, and Rahul plays it to point
bang! Six down the ground! Porel finds his feet, as he lofts this length ball on middle and off to go through the line. It is a clean swing of the bat, and ball goes flying over the bowler's head
quite full again, and this swings in to come on middle. It is whipped wide of long-on, and Rahul is happy with a single
on a full length on middle and off, and clipped to deep midwicket. Rahul pushes for two, and he gets it
a crunching drive to deep cover! The ball is full, and angling across to arrive outside off, and Porel creams it all along the ground

Porel gets lucky! It was a shortish ball at 145kph from Prasidh, with the ball arriving around middle and off. Porel went pulling, but the ball flew off the top edge, and went over the keeper's head. Arshad, at deep third, moves to his right, to try and save a boundary. He even pulls the ball back, but momentum is taking him beyond the boundary. His right leg, though, touches the toblerone in the process of looking to parry the ball back. So it's a four
again Rahul backs away, and Prasidh bowls short, and on middle and off. Punched to deep third off the outside half of the bat
short in length on the stumps, and pulled flat by Rahul. It went on the bounce to the man at deep midwicket
shortish in length on middle and leg, and nudged to midwicket
Porel shapes to skip down the pitch, but Rashid bowls full and quick on leg. The ball hits Porel's pads eventually as he looked to heave
the googly outside off, and on a fullish length. The ball turns in, and is pushed to long-on
on a length, and just outside leg. Porel looked to swipe, but the ball went off his pad to short fine leg
bowls full and wide-ish of off. Rahul drives hard, and the ball ricochets off Rashid's right leg to long-on
on a fullish length, and swinging in to arrive on middle. Driven to long-on
short on leg, and dabbed to the on side as he rides the bounce, and gets his bottom hand off the bat
short in length on the stumps, and punched to midwicket

Rahul backs away way too early, and Prasidh has enough time to follow. Prasidh bowls this short and outside leg, and ends up bowling on Rahul's pads. The latter looked to clip, and got a single towards short fine leg
shortish in length on off, and Rahul pulls it hard towards deep square leg. Good work by Shahrukh, who was at deep-backward square, and ran and tumbled to his left to stop a boundary
this swings in, and lands on a good length around off. Rahul goes back to push towards cover
short in length, and just outside off. He opens the face of the bat late, and punches to deep backward point

lovely shot! Perhaps this will remain the best from the day. This is a fullish delivery around seventh stump, and Rahul remains deep in the crease, takes a good stride out, and launches it over mid-off. It went into the first tier

slapped over cover point. Another mistimed slog, but maybe the pitch is slow and grippy. Anyway, Rabada went short and pretty wide of off, ad Rahul reached out with a flat bat to deposit the ball for another four
short in length on the stumps, and it hits Rahul on the body on leg as he looks to hook but misses

wow! Shot! Rabada switched his length to go short, and just outside off, but Rahul went slightly across the stumps, and hooked it hard. The ball seemed to have gone off the top half of the bat, but still flew for six over fine leg
starts with one on a good length on middle and off. Rahul clips this to midwicket by leaping in the crease
on a good length, and on a tight line around off. Pushed to mid-on for a quick single
Rahul opens the face of the bat last moment off this length ball just outside off, and guides the ball to short third
nearly a yorker on off at 142kph, and Rahul drags it to mid-on from deep in the crease
swung over mid-on. It didn't look all that well-timed, but was still good enough for a boundary. Siraj bowled on the shorter side of a length outside off, and Rahul swiped at it to go across the line
on a good length around sixth stump. Rahul looked to clip it away, but got an inside edge close to the stumps

slapped wide of point! Rahul made room early, and Siraj followed, but in vain, Siraj bowled it short and on the stumps, getting the ball to finish well outside leg. But Rahul had enough room to dispatch it to point's left

Rabada at point tumbles to his left to save a boundary! It was another outswinger from Arshad to Porel, as the ball arrived at a full length slightly wide of off. Porel went driving through the line, and all but got a boundary

there's a noise as the ball passes the bat, but it's of the bat banging the ground. Arshad swung this away from Porel, and went on a yorker length around seventh stump. Porel went flashing with a flat bat, but missed
wide outside leg. This was angled in, and on a good length on leg. It went down with the angle as Porel looked to swipe but missed
on the shorter side of a length on middle, and punched down to mid-on's left for a hurried single
shortish in length on middle, and Porel gets slightly across to stylishly pull it to fine leg

gone! Taken at mid-on! Du Plessis' struggle ends. Arshad switched his length to slightly fuller than the previous ball, and swung this into the batter. The ball arrived on middle and leg, and du Plessis nearly seemed cramped for room. He ended up lofting it off the inside half of the bat to Siraj's right
finally du Plessis gets the ball away... but still not a boundary. He made some room, and skipped down the pitch, before slicing this length ball outside off aerially, and over cover
on a shortish length on middle and off, and flicked towards midwicket. Rahul sets off for a single, but is sent back by du Plessis. The throw goes at Rahul's end, but is wide of the stumps
on the shorter side of a length on off, as du Plessis backs away and looks to slap, but gets a bottom edge rolling towards cover. That continues his sluggish start tonight
short in length on off, and clipped to deep square leg
beaten! Shorter side of a length from Siraj, who went around fifth stump, and got the ball to shape back in. Rahul went pulling hard but missed, and the ball just went over the off stump
short of a length just outside off, and finishing on top of the stumps. Punched to extra cover

a mistimed pull over the man at mid-on. Short in length around sixth stump, before the ball seams back in, and there's some considerable bounce for Siraj, with the ball going off the higher side of du Plessis' bat
he finally gets off the mark, as he slashes at this length ball just outside off to the left of the man tumbling at cover point
a full ball swinging in to pitch on middle, and du Plessis is nearly cramped for room, before he pushes back off the inside half of the bat
shorter side of a length again, but this is just outside off. Cut away between short cover and point
on a good length, and around fifth stump. Du Plessis again goes slapping, but this one goes on the bounce to the man placed at a catching cover
another ball on the shorter side, but this is on the stumps. The ball arrives around middle, and is punched towards cover point
short of a length, and outside leg. Du Plessis looked to clip but missed, and it is called wide
angles this across, and bowls short and around sixth stump. Slashed towards cover off the bottom of the bat
punched between point and cover point! Short in length, and around sixth stump, as Rahul rides the bounce and presents the full face of the bat to find the gap for four
back of a length, and cut towards point

off the outside half of the bat, but wide of slip. It seemed like good work by Rutherford sliding to his left to keep this to a single, but replays show Rutherford's foot had touched the boundary cushion. Rahul drove forward off this short-of-a-length ball outside off
wide called, but it looked tight. Short of a length on middle and leg, and seaming in to finish just outside leg, as Rahul looked to nudge but missed
shorter side of a length on off, and the ball seems to straighten after pitching. Rahul blocks it down on the pitch
fuller in length, and again just outside off or thereabouts. Pushed back towards Siraj by Rahul
on a good length just outside off, and Rahul dabs it down as the bat turns in his hands

Finished in style. Pulled away over long-on to take GT on top and into the playoffs. Was a wide length ball that spun away but the slowness allowed Sudharsan to rock ball and almost caress it. Sent it sailing though
Length on fourth, bunted to deep point off the back foot. Scores tied
Pulls the length ball across from fifth stump to deep square leg. Bottom hand came off but the timing was good
Length ball lands down leg and beats the sweep. Pops to the off side, keeper collects it on the bounce
Low full toss on fifth is slow, driven to deep cover
Touch short, very flat, cut to the right of deep point
Very slow again, shortish on fourth. Gill was early into the pull, top edged but there was no infielder at midwicket, so it landed safely and rolled to the deep
Real short. Even Kuldeep seems to have given up. Fourth-stump ball is pulled along the ground to deep midwicket's left
Fullish 90ks ball lands on leg and turns in a bit. Sudharsan makes room and drives to long-off
Full outside off, driven to cover
Sight-screen drive to get to a 100, had to be orthodox. Sudharsan pumps his fist and looks intently at the dugout as it stands. Was an overpitched ball at the stumps
Bad start, gets away with it though. Overpitched on the pads, Gill swept aerially, Vipraj at deep square leg goes left and stops it over his right shoulder with one hand
Into the pitch, wide, and it's cut to deep point
Kohli-esque whippy flick over deep midwicket. It's a slot ball on fourth, went straight off the pitch
Too wide and Gill cuts it to the left of backward point. Cutter on a length around seventh stump, Gill crouched a bit and whacked it into the ground
Length on leg, clipped to midwicket. 122ks
This is the 17th over of a T20 but it might as well be a Test with an on-drive like that. Long-off was out but had no chance.
Overpitched on the pads, yorker missed that. Whipped over midwicket, Stubbs at deep midwicket charges right and throws the ball in while tumbling. Replay confirms he's saved two
Length on fourth, punched back to the bowler
Pace-on yorker at middle, Sudharsan skis to the left while working it to long-on
Fullish on fourth, pushed to the left of cover. All too easy after two fours to start the over
Slower one on a three-quarter length at fourth, bunted to point

Mirrors it this time placement-wise. Short third is beaten to the left. Was a scrambled-seam length ball on fifth, waited for it to reach the top of the bounce and guided it with an open-faced vertical bat
Short fine's in, so Sudharsan gets low to sweep the low, slow full toss to his right
Wide and full, 93ks, Gill reaches out and swipes it into the ground. Bowler doesn't take it on the first go but is able to deny the single by running back. Timeout
Fullish on fifth, driven to deep cover point
Low fully down leg. Goes past the flick
Fullish ball rushes towards middle after landing around off, Gill was making room but had to hurry and jam the bat to punch it through point
Full on leg, 97ks, worked to deep midwicket
Length on fifth, chopped to point. 150 up for GT
Overpitched and that's effortlessly driven over long-on. It's a step-hit for Gill and he holds his shape beautifully
Length on off, 86ks, clipped off the back foot to deep midwicket
One-knee sweep is a touch aerial and takes the full ball to long-on
Makes room early but Kuldeep floats it on off, might've turned it away a touch. Sudharsan looks to drive through cover, inside edges onto pad
Gets away with a loose ball. Tried following Sudharsan as he made room but got it too short, the pull found deep square leg
Touch short, very slow, low bounce. Gill works it from outside off to long-on, off the back foot
Very wide. Googly was a touch short, Gill's back foot went across and then he reached out to cut it behind point. Beats Rahul who was the sweeper
Short and wide, Sudharsan's jump-cut will put video editors to shame. Ball clears the infield at cover and races away
Shortish over the stumps, short-arm pulled to long-on
Picked up this time. Legcutter on leg stump, was full and Gill essentially swept it. Popped the front foot centimetres forward, feet stayed remarkably still while he bent down and broomed it
Cannoned back, almost takes out the bowler. Chameera does well to get low in time. Was a low fully on off that Gill short-arm drove flat ad hard. Brings up his 33-ball fifty too, raises his bat
Fullish ball goes down leg, goes past the attempted whip aimed to take it fine

Slower one almost has Gill caught at cover. Leading edge off the flick ballooned and stayed in the air for a while, Axar went right and reached out with his right hand but wasn't in reach. Was a full one at the pad that Gill tried to clip square, played too early
Hard length, fourth stump, pulled to long-on
Goes for the yorker, gets it full instead. Driven from middle and off to long-off
Tennis shot. Forehand pull to long-on. Was a short ball on fifth
Slower one on a length, pulled long-on. Bat-face turned inwards there
Bouncer on sixth. Tennis-ball bounce, Gill waits before cutting to short third
Yorker on leg, jammed to long-on
And his poor return continues. No-look whip over midwicket from Sudharsan. Got one touch too straight, whacked the fullish ball 82 metres far
A touch short on fifth, cut to deep point
Gill yells in disappointment despite nailing the pull. It's because he finds deep-backward point
Looped up and Gill leans forward to cream it over long-off. Showed all three stumps to stay beside the line, got the big stride straight forward and extended his arms through the drive
again Nigam bowls short, and just outside off. Punched down to long-on
short in length again, and around off. Gill slaps it to deep-backward point
shortish in length, and slightly wide of off. Slapped to deep cover point
fullish ball dipping on off, and punched to extra cover
much slower from Kuldeep, who goes full and outside leg. Gill looks to flick but misses. Wide called
on a length on middle and leg, and turning in. Whipped to deep midwicket after getting his front leg out of the way
fuller and slower on middle and off. Swept away to fine leg
down the pitch, and bang! Another six for Gill. The ball was tossed up, and angling across to pitch just outside off. Gill got to the pitch of the ball, and launched it down the ground
this turns away from the left-hander, as Kuldeep goes full and just outside off. Cut away to deep cover
the wrong 'un. This dips on a fullish length on middle, and finishes just outside off. Whipped wide of long-on
he skips down the pitch, and looks to whip this length ball on the stumps, but is hit on the pad
Axar slows it down further, and bowls on a length, and wide of off. Slapped to deep cover point
slower and fuller, and on off. Blocked down by Gill
lovely shot! The sound off the bat must have resonated miles far. Gill slog sweeps this tossed up and loppy ball, which dips on a full length outside off, and times it wonderfully well
on a length on the stumps, and pushed to deep midwicket
swept to beat short fine leg to his right. That is also SS' fifty, as he went low at this full ball outside leg, and dispatched it for four
full and dipping on off, and driven to long-off. There's a fumble there, but it remains a single
Gill steps down the pitch, and clips this length ball on the stumps to deep midwicket
this is fullish on off, and turns away. Punched to deep cover
this is again full, and a little wide of off. This time Gill leans into a drive to long-off
full and tossed up, and wide-ish of off. Swiped wide of long-on for two

a confident and an animated appeal for lbw first ball, but turned down. It thought it was heading down leg... but Axar reviews. The ball was on a length around off, and turning in. SS looked to flick it away from the stumps, but was beaten on the inside edge. UltraEdge shows there's no bat involved, so we move on to ball tracking. Ohh, the ball is shown to be dipping on middle, and there's an umpire's call on clipping the edge of the leg stump. In the meanwhile, the batters got a leg bye
this is short, and outside off. It hints to turn away, as SS slaps it to deep cover
short in length at Gull too, as Nigam bowls on middle and off. Pulled to deep midwicket
nice turn for Nigam! He bowls on a full length on off, and the ball sharply turns away, before Gill jabs it to short third
short in length, and outside off. SS pulls hard, and wide of long-on

Porel and Nigam are up in celebration for a potential caught behind, but the umpire is unmoved. Both look up to Axar, who agrees for a review. Nigam bowled on the shorter side, and outside leg. The ball just shaped to turn back in, as SS looked to have a swipe at it. UltraEdge shows a flat line, as the ball goes from below the bat. There's a flicker there, but of the ball nudging the pad. So DC lose a review
he tosses it up first ball, and goes full and just outside off. Gill leans into the drive to deep cover
another slower ball, and this is on a fullish length just outside off. Pushed awkwardly towards mid-off by Gill
very full from Fizz, how shapes this in to middle and off. SS drives to extra cover, where there's a fumble from Nigam, and that allows SS a single
slapped to deep-backward point. SS waits for this short-of-a-length ball to arrive in the corridor, and plays late to find the gap for four
change of pace, and this is full and on the stumps. Whipped to Rahul again at midwicket
great fielding by Rahul at midwicket. He tumbles to his right to prevent a boundary, after SS made room and flicked a low full toss angling into him and coming on to his pads
full delivery angling across, and pitching outside off. Gill looks to drive forward, but gets it off the bottom of the bat to midwicket
a low full toss on middle and off, and whipped to du Plessis at mid-on
fullish length, and around fifth stump. Punched to mid-off
slower ball from Chameera, as he goes on a length on leg. SS clips it towards square leg
now SS looks to be creative. He tries to scoop Chameera, but the length is too short for that shot. The ball is on middle, and bounces over the stumps after SS misses
good work by du Plessis at mid-on, as he moves and tumbles to his left to keep this to a single. Shorter side of a length from Chameera around off, and Gill swatted it back down the ground
floats this on a fullish length, and on off or thereabouts at 141kph. Gill drives confidently to mid-off
again Fizz goes wide of the crease, and bowls this on the shorter side just outside off. It is whipped to deep square leg for two
short of a length, and just outside off. SS guides it to short third after playing it from deep in the crease
Fizz slows it down this time. Short in length on leg, and it finishes on middle, as Gill clips towards midwicket
the call is for two right away, and Gill gets it. The ball is shortish on middle and off, and is slapped to deep cover. The man out is at deep-backward point, so Gill gets two rather comfortably

on the shorter side of a length outside off, and the ball stays low while seaming in. It arrives just outside off, and SS gets a bottom edge as he looks to pull. The ball dribbles away to the off side
goes wide of the crease first ball, and bowls on a length just outside off. Punched to mid-on
on a length on middle and leg, and quicker. Punched to mid-on's left for a quick single
in the massive gap between point and extra cover. This time SS gets his front leg out of the way at this shortish ball outside off, and cuts hard

Nigam, at extra cover, dives to his right and gets a hand, but that is not enough to stop the boundary. Short in length, and angling across to arrive outside off, as SS shifts his weight back to hack for four
full and on the stumps, and driven to long-off
fullish ball outside leg, and he backs away to nudge to deep midwicket
on a length, and slower and just outside off. Gill punches, but off the inside half of the bat towards midwicket

the ball flies off the outside edge, and four more for Sai Sudharsan. Natarajan bowls an outswinger, albeit on a much fuller length. This ball arrives wide of off, and Sai Sudharsan goes driving and gets lucky
another one which swing away, but this pitches on a good length and in the corridor outside off. Punched towards deep cover, and they push for two
shorter side of a length again, but this is much closer to off. Sai Sudharsan punches hard to mid-on, with a high right elbow
this is great batting! He punches this short-of-a-length ball around sixth stump through extra cover, and beats the man at deep cover to his left
slapped to deep-backward point. Natarajan swung this away, but bowled on the shorter side, and wide of off. Sai Sudharsan had plenty of room to cut away for four
six for Sai Sudharsan too! Short of a length on leg, and Sai Sudharsan waits before having a full swipe at it for a flat six over fine leg

bam! Six over deep midwicket! You don't really see Gill reaching out for a ball outside off, and dispatch it across the line. This one was on a length, and around sixth stump, as he swung full stretch, and just cleared the boundary
on a length around middle and off, and straightening after pitching. Gill pushes to extra cover
